chapter: Reading, repertoire and New Orleans players
title: Monk Hazel and brother Jules's band
summary: He recalls Monk Hazel in his brother's band and later with Sharkey.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Playing with and understanding Thelonious Monk

blocks.x: How did Monk Hazel rate in those days? He played good drums.

Monk was a good drum. I don't know whether he was a great reader or not, but like I say... No. I mean... He played with my brother Jules for quite a while. Yeah. In different bands around the world. He played... Then later on he went with... He went with Sharky, see. And when I left Jimmy Darcy in 51, I came down there. Sharky said, man... He said, the guy driving in... He gets knocked out of his skull and he can't play. Yeah. I said, well... Well, Sharky, I don't wanna mess you up. But... You better keep him because I don't know if any other drummer on here. Yeah. And I told him what I was gonna do and get the band together with Jack Teagle, I don't know. You know. Yeah. But Monk... Monk played with my brother Jules's band. I got a picture of my brother's band somewhere and see how...
Yeah, well... It'll turn up. I can come back tomorrow... And look at him some more. You have time tomorrow? I... It's alright with me, but I'm saying...
I never know... I got him so mixed up in... Oh, yeah, well...
